dialogues.speaker: Souka
dialogues.text: Where could Lady Yae be...? Could it be that the routes I've chosen are too boring?

response.speaker: Souka
response.text: Yeah! Miss Aratani has no idea either... Do you guys know where Lady Yae went?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: What's going on? We heard that you guys left with someone that looked like a mercenary. Did you guys split up?

response.speaker: Souka
response.text: Mercenary? Oh, you mean the guide from the Corps of Thirty? We were just asking for directions to some famous local restaurant.

response.speaker: Souka
response.text: The mercenary left after we arrived at the restaurant. Lady Yae was interested in the spices they used in the dishes and wanted to bring some back as souvenirs. So she went to look for a spice shop afterward...

response.speaker: Souka
response.text: But she's been gone for a whole three hours now!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: It's only been three hours...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Ahh, you scared Paimon there... You made it sound as if Miko's been missing for a really long time!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Maybe she saw something interesting and stuck around to take a closer look. There's no need to panic!

response.speaker: Souka
response.text: But we only have so much time on this trip to Sumeru, and I want to spend as much time with Lady Yae as possible! I want to learn as much as I can from her...

response.speaker: Souka
response.text: Sometimes, a simple comment of hers can be extremely insightful to an inexperienced writer like me. This is a rare opportunity!

response.speaker: Souka
response.text: Just now, for instance, I felt a kind of... hostile vibe from the mercenary that showed us the way. He kept looking at us as if he was planning on robbing us!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: There's no need to be scared, it's not like you did anything wrong! That mercenary was probably just on patrol. It would make sense to take notice of everyone around you when you're patrolling.

response.speaker: Souka
response.text: I'm not scared! But it seems like Lady Yae already noticed that he was watching us and said quietly to me, "If you suspect that someone's watching you, this is something you can do to turn the tables..."

response.speaker: Souka
response.text: Lady Yae then called out to the mercenary and asked him to be our guide! The mercenary looked dumbfounded but quickly agreed to her request.

response.speaker: Souka
response.text: The mercenary was nowhere to be seen again after taking us to the restaurant. I think it might've been because Lady Yae messed up his plans, and he was scared of making any bold moves.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Wow... you can do that?

response.speaker: Souka
response.text: Isn't Lady Yae so cool!? I'm gonna add this to my novel——

response.speaker: Souka
response.text: Actively engaging with someone you suspect of following you... Disrupt their plans and force an unexpected change in their scheme to buy yourself more time...

response.speaker: Souka
response.text: But where does the story go from there? What if they return? Lady Yae said that she was going to buy some spices, but what if she secretly went to track the mercenary instead?

response.speaker: Souka
response.text: I think I've got it! This is the classic, take your opponent by surprise and checkmate them before they can react! Bring the fight to them while they're rallying and making adjustments!

response.speaker: Souka
response.text: Hmm? That means I have nothing to worry about!

response.speaker: Souka
response.text: As expected of Lady Yae. I'm getting so excited just thinking about it!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yeah, but now Paimon is also curious about who that mercenary is.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Let's ask Miko when we get a chance.

choices.text: The mercenaries of the Corps of Thirty are good people...
We'll go look for her as well...

response.speaker: Souka
response.text: That would be great! If you find Lady Yae, please remind... I mean... suggest that she quickly return and meet up with us! I still have many things I'd like to ask her about!
